hook: Jane Austen Signed This Letter M.A.D.
text: In eighteen hundred and three, a London publisher bought Jane Austen's novel Susan for ten pounds. Then he simply put it away in a drawer. Six years later she wrote to him, politely asking what had happened. She signed her letter with an invented name, Mrs Ashton Dennis. Her initials spelled the word MAD. He replied that she could have the manuscript back, for the same ten pounds. She could not afford it. Seven years later, her brother Henry bought it back for her at last, and the book became Northanger Abbey.
